description: This file defines the SharedFdGatekeeperChannel class, which implements a communication channel for Gatekeeper IPC/RPC calls over shared file descriptors, enabling synchronous message exchanges with Gatekeeper services.

classes.name: SharedFdGatekeeperChannel
classes.description: A class that manages IPC/RPC communication with Gatekeeper using shared file descriptors, inheriting from GatekeeperChannel.

methods.name: SharedFdGatekeeperChannel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the channel with input and output file descriptors.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends a request message with a command and GateKeeperMessage.

methods.name: SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response message with a command and GateKeeperMessage.

methods.name: ReceiveMessage
methods.description: Receives a message from the shared file descriptor channel.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Internal method to send a message with command, response flag, and message.
